title: BeamNG Research SDK (BRSDK): High-Frequency In-Engine Telemetry Framework and Scientific Python SDK for Sim2Real Autonomous Vehicle Research
description:
BRSDK (BeamNG Research SDK) is an open-source, dual-runtime computational framework engineered to bridge the Simulation-to-Real (Sim2Real) reality gap in autonomous driving, vehicle dynamics, and reinforcement learning within BeamNG.drive and BeamNG.tech.

Core Capabilities

  • 2,000 Hz Soft-Body In-Engine Telemetry: Operates directly inside the sandboxed Vehicle Lua Virtual Machine with zero dynamic heap allocations on the hot path, capturing continuous ground-truth physical states (sub-millisecond transient dynamics, tire slip breakaway energy, suspension travel & damper velocities, wheel loads, and chassis compliance).
  • RFC 8259 Provenance Metadata Sidecars: Emits deterministic per-run metadata sidecars recording engine clocks, physics steps, vehicle config hashes, and run manifests.
  • Scientific Python SDK (brsdk): Backed by Apache Arrow columnar memory and Polars query acceleration, featuring strict Pydantic V2 schema validation and zero-copy DLPack interchange with PyTorch and Minari (offline reinforcement learning).

Release v2.0.1 Highlights

  • Author metadata formally synchronized to Kartikeya Gangwar (ORCID: 0009-0009-1973-7532).
  • Automated Zenodo metadata integration sidecar (.zenodo.json).
  • Package distribution metadata and citation compliance updates.
